sections.title: Fixed
items: One controller tap no longer moves the selection two rows: the duplicate press mirrored through the legacy Windows joystick API is now recognized and dropped instead of being replayed a quarter second later.
The joystick fallback backend no longer enumerates a controller the XInput backend already owns, removing the second event stream behind the double-input reports.

Share/Capture and Guide buttons can now reach GameHQ while a game holds focus: the modern controller session requests background delivery for standard input and the system buttons (never exclusively - the game keeps its input).

sections.title: Improved
items: Identify a controller button now explains keyboard-macro buttons: if a button only sends a Windows keyboard shortcut (as some GameSir Share buttons do), the probe says so and suggests binding it in the Keyboard section or remapping it to an unused key such as F13.
When the probe sees no event at all, it notes that the current controller firmware mode may disable the button entirely.

sections.title: Notes
items: When using JoyXoff or another controller-to-mouse/keyboard mapper, add GameHQ to its ignored applications; otherwise GameHQ receives both native controller input and the generated keyboard or mouse input.
